title: add-rag-agent-examples-tool-calling-quickstarts-docs-update
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds RAG agent documentation, quickstart walkthroughs, and two tool-calling example playbooks (Python + TypeScript). Motivation: provide a repeatable onboarding path for engineers evaluating Redwood agents with external tool integrations and to surface recommended patterns for request routing, tool schemas, and output validation. Includes a short quickstart that walks through: 1) configuring a local RAG index, 2) wiring agent tool endpoints, 3) running the included playbooks, and 4) running the docs-driven eval. Checklist: [x] Add docs page with step-by-step quickstart and diagrams, [x] Add Python and TypeScript example agents with tool-calling stubs, [x] Add CI docs lint and example smoke tests, [x] Update examples README and changelog. Related: ENG-4821 (RAG agent template work), PM-233 (docs launch). Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-internal/rag-agent-quickstarts
